papers_found.title: ChatGPT as a Time Capsule: The Limits of Price Discovery
papers_found.notes: Frozen GPT snapshots (12 snapshots, ~7,000 equities, 2021-2025) predict 12-month revenue growth and analyst revisions (t-stat=6.02 pooled panel). Predictability stronger for high-analyst-coverage firms. Sector-neutral score. Distinct from H225/H226 (event-driven PEAD tone) — this is a slow-moving monthly fundamental factor. Actionable as H239 using our 30-stock large-cap universe.

papers_found.title: Can Blindfolded LLMs Still Trade? An Anonymization-First Framework for Portfolio Optimization
papers_found.notes: BlindTrade: anonymize tickers before LLM portfolio scoring to eliminate memorization bias. 4-agent ensemble. Sharpe 1.40±0.22 on 2025 YTD (20 seeds). Excels in volatile conditions. Directly addresses root cause of H225/H226 failure and is actionable as H238.

papers_found.title: StockBench: Can LLM Agents Trade Stocks Profitably In Real-world Markets?
papers_found.notes: Real-market test March-July 2025. Most LLM agents fail to beat buy-and-hold. Critical negative result: financial QA performance does not predict trading performance. Complements reproducibility warning already in ml-for-trading.md.

papers_found.title: From Knowing to Doing: A Memory-Controlled Benchmark for LLM Trading Agents
papers_found.notes: KTD-Fin: LLM agent positive returns are largely market/style beta, not alpha. Anonymization test shows memorization contamination. 10-dimensional metric framework. Key for H238/H239 validation protocol.

papers_found.title: Toward Expert Investment Teams: A Multi-Agent LLM System with Fine-Grained Trading Tasks
papers_found.notes: Fine-grained task decomposition significantly improves LLM trading risk-adjusted returns. Applied to PEAD: adding guidance quality classification as a third filter alongside FinBERT score and EPS surprise. Academic support from Nguyen et al. 2022 (guidance raise is strongest PEAD continuation predictor). Actionable as H240.

papers_found.title: AI-Driven Alpha Decay: Algorithmic Homogenization, Reflexive Signal Erosion, and the Paradox of Intelligent Markets
papers_found.notes: Used for Phase 1 wiki expansion (signal-halflife.md). Alpha half-life formula h(phi) = ln2/(theta + delta(phi)); current AI adoption implies 18-month half-life vs 5-7 years pre-AI. Not staged separately — content already incorporated into wiki page.

papers_found.title: ATLAS: Adaptive Trading with LLM AgentS Through Dynamic Prompt Optimization and Multi-Agent Coordination
papers_found.notes: Adaptive-OPRO beats fixed prompts for LLM trading agents. Relevant to future PEAD pipeline improvements. Not staged — insufficient detail from abstract to produce actionable hypothesis without accessing full paper results.

papers_found.title: Pairs trading with time-series deep learning models
papers_found.notes: Time-series DL for cointegrated pairs. Behind ScienceDirect paywall (403). Insufficient detail to stage. Pairs family already exhausted (H152-H160 ETF, H200 NOT CONFIRMED stock-level). Low priority.
